description: This file defines the Configuration class within the AWS SDK's ClientSideMonitoring namespace. The class manages configuration options for client-side monitoring, including host, port, enabled status, and client ID, and provides methods to access and serialize these settings.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Represents the configuration settings for client-side monitoring, including host, port, enabled status, and client ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Configuration instance with specified enabled flag, host, port, and optional client ID.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether client-side monitoring is enabled.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the configuration into an array.
